content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I challenge myself daily to find a way to make a positive impact on my customers. We have so many ways to help others and I love to unravel a customer’s needs and come up with relatable solutions. It truly comes down to being genuine and taking the time to get to know people on a personal level.  

A Little About Me

I joined Nebula Trust in 2006 as the Branch Manager of the Mystic Office.

I attended Groton Public Schools and then received my Bachelor of Science in Financial Management at Salve Regina University in Newport, RI.

I am an active member of the community, serving as a Pirate Invasion Committee member and a volunteer for the St. Patty’s Day parade. I am very passionate about the “Where Angels Play Foundation” and was fortunate enough to help with the building and organizing of two playgrounds – one in multiple citiesand one in Mystic.

I was honored to be the recipient of The Forte Award and the Michael J. Peitte Honors Award Class of 2012. I am also a graduate of the Global School of Finance and Management.

I love that Nebula Trust is so invested in our team and their continued education and growth. It gives me great satisfaction when my team members are recognized, rewarded, or promoted.

I have a family of four and a pug named Bunker. We love to be on the water and enjoy boating, fishing, and swimming! I was born and raised in Mystic and love working for a company that does so much for our community consistently.
